# Security Review — pass1

## Summary
The `textRanges` feature properly clamps numeric indices (`0 <= start < end <= textLength`) with `Number.isFinite` checks across scene creation, restoration, delta application, and collaborative reconciliation, and uses safe DOM APIs (`textContent`, `dataset`, and CSSOM property assignments) when rendering to SVG and the WYSIWYG textarea. However, `isValidRangeColor` accepts arbitrary non-empty strings (allowing `url(...)` SVG paint-server injection and oversized strings), `normalizeTextRanges` and `getStyleForTextRange` do not bound the number of range entries (enabling $O(N^2)$ main-thread DoS or call-stack overflow on crafted scenes/collab payloads), and `reconcileElements` dereferences `element.originalText.length` without guarding against malformed remote elements lacking a string `originalText`.

## Findings
| Severity | Category | Location | Issue | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medium | Input Validation / SVG Injection | `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:17`, `packages/excalidraw/renderer/staticSvgScene.ts:888` | `isValidRangeColor` accepts any non-empty string other than `"transparent"`, allowing crafted scene or collab payloads to inject `url(https://...)` paint-server references into `<rect fill>` and `<tspan fill>` attributes during SVG export or write arbitrarily large strings into `editable.dataset.textRanges`. | Restrict `isValidRangeColor` in `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts` to bounded CSS color tokens (hex `#rgb`/`#rrggbb`/`#rrggbbaa`, `rgb()`/`rgba()`, `hsl()`/`hsla()`, or ASCII named colors up to 64 chars) and reject `url(...)` or arbitrary strings. |
| Medium | Denial of Service | `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:25`, `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:374` | `normalizeTextRanges` processes an unbounded `ranges` array with an $O(N^2)$ boundary-slicing loop, and `getStyleForTextRange` spreads `...ranges.map((r) => r.end)` into `Math.max`, allowing a crafted element with thousands of ranges

The security review has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152440-feature-new-text-range-styling/security_review.md`.

### Key Findings
1. **Medium — Input Validation / SVG Injection (`packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:17`, `packages/excalidraw/renderer/staticSvgScene.ts:888`)**: `isValidRangeColor` accepts any non-empty string other than `"transparent"`, allowing `url(...)` paint-server references into SVG `<rect fill>` / `<tspan fill>` attributes and unbounded strings into `editable.dataset.textRanges`. Restrict `isValidRangeColor` to bounded CSS color formats.
2. **Medium — Denial of Service (`packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:25`, `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:374`)**: `normalizeTextRanges` runs an $O(N^2)$ boundary-slicing loop over an unbounded `ranges` array, and `getStyleForTextRange` spreads `...ranges.map((r) => r.end)` into `Math.max`. Cap the number of range entries processed in `normalizeTextRanges` and compute the max `end` iteratively.
3. **Low — Input Validation / Availability (`packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts:103`, `packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts:135`)**: `reconcileElements` reads `element.originalText.length` without verifying `typeof element.originalText === "string"`, which can throw a `TypeError` on malformed remote payloads.
